Michigan court upholds permanent easement after neighbours block family's 35-year driveway
articles.description: In Michigan, a family dispute erupted when construction activities obstructed a crucial driveway. David Lee Shattuck initiated a lawsuit against his relatives, Mark and Michelle Shattuck, to regain access. Although the court initially denied his preliminary request, it later favored David's permanent easement claim. This decision was upheld by the Michigan Court of Appeals, ensuring that David can maintain access to the driveway despite the ongoing disagreements.

articles.title: ‘ITI students deserve the same respect as IIT students’, says PM Modi
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of vocational education at the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow. He urged society to respect students attending Industrial Training Institutes equally with those in universities. Modi pointed out the stigma surrounding ITI enrolment and the need for a shift in this mindset. He highlighted how industries rely on ITI-trained workers for their daily operations and success.

articles.title: Assam announces Rs 4,000 crore skill development plan to transform ITIs into Centres of Excellence
articles.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma has outlined an investment plan exceeding Rs 4,000 crore to transform ITIs and strengthen vocational education. The initiatives include a Rs 2,390 crore modernisation programme covering 77 technical institutions, a Rs 1,016 crore Assam Skill University and a Rs 600 crore rural skill network. The state is also developing industry-linked training clusters, nine Multi-Skill Centres of Excellence and an international skill centre in Guwahati.

articles.title: JKSSB cheating case: 20 accused arrested, including six government employees, as investigation widens
articles.description: As per reports, 20 people, including six government employees, have been arrested in connection with alleged cheating during the JKSSB Finance Accounts Assistant examination held on November 15. Police said an insider allegedly obtained a question paper from an examination centre, which was photographed and circulated through a Telegram group. A Special Investigation Team expanded the probe following 14 initial arrests. Meanwhile, the JK Students Association has sought a CBI investigation and postponement of upcoming examinations.

articles.title: KEA UG AYUSH Round 3 Seat Allotment Result 2026 released, check final result and admission dates
articles.description: KEA UG AYUSH Seat Allotment 2026: The Karnataka Examinations Authority has announced the provisional third-round seat allotment results for UG AYUSH admissions 2026, with 2,471 candidates receiving seats. The final allotment results are scheduled for November 23 after 11 AM. Selected candidates must pay the prescribed fees and download their Seat Allotment or Confirmation Letter between November 23 and 25. They must complete admission formalities at their allotted colleges by November 26, 2026.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson was paid $1 million to screen test for the upcoming ‘James Bond’ film
articles.description: Robert Pattinson managed to secure a hefty payment of one million dollars for a nude audition to land the iconic James Bond role. The audition was a bold attempt to replicate a legendary scene from the 1963 classic, ‘From Russia with Love.’ Following numerous casting setbacks, it was director Denis Villeneuve who endorsed Pattinson, recognizing the unique attributes that he believed were ideal for the next James Bond.
